item.description: The rlp_encode function currently requires the 'rlp' package to be installed, but tests expect it to work without this dependency. Additionally, the function signature doesn't match what tests expect - it's receiving unexpected 'str_mode' keyword arguments.
item.contract: Implement a self-contained RLP encoding/decoding solution that doesn't rely on external dependencies. The function should support the 'str_mode' parameter and handle various data types correctly. The rlp_encode function should accept a 'str_mode' parameter and behave according to the test expectations.
item.acceptance: Tests passing: test_rlp_encode_integer, test_rlp_decoding_ascii, test_rlp_encode_address, test_rlp_encode_address_integer_tuples, test_rlp_encoding
